mapper.select: SELECT id, approval_id, approval_key, run_id, tool_call_id, status, permission_mode, arguments_hash, options_ref, user_answer_ref, created_at, decided_at FROM agent_tool_approval WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, approval_id, approval_key, run_id, tool_call_id, status, permission_mode, arguments_hash, options_ref, user_answer_ref, created_at, decided_at FROM agent_tool_approval WHERE approval_key = #{approvalKey} LIMIT 1
